svg.text: PR #1912 · pointer-safe modal backdrop dismissal
Selecting text past a modal edge no longer dismisses the dialog.
BEFORE
AFTER
A bubbling click closes the backdrop
pointer starts over selectable modal text
selection drag ends outside the pane
browser targets the common backdrop ancestor
dialog closes and the selection is lost
Dismiss logic was copied across overlays
shared panes and hand-built dialogs used onclick
stopPropagation cannot intercept this click target
DismissibleBackdrop tracks pointer origin
pointerdown must begin directly on the backdrop
matching pointerup must also end on the backdrop
selection and cross-boundary drags keep modal open
pointer cancellation clears the armed press
One behavior for every dismissible overlay
FloatingPane plus seven hand-built backdrop sites
unit tests cover drags, cancellation, and pointer IDs
Scope: frontend interaction only; modal layout, Escape handling, and focus traps are unchanged.
